# What should this water well cost?

> Free water well drilling bid calculator: depth by formation, casing, grout, pump and tank, trench, mobilization and rig hours, plus a dry-hole allowance, priced to your margin with break-even and price per foot. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/water-well-drilling-bid-calculator/)
